attchmntText: Power Mech Projects Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Power Mech Projects Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 13, 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of INR1,609 crores for Q2 FY27, a 30% year-on-year increase. EBITDA stood at INR187 crores, up 18% year-on-year, while profit after tax was INR88 crores, a 12% increase. For the first half of FY27, revenue reached INR3,233 crores, up 28%, with PAT at INR177 crores, up 12%. The company secured fresh orders worth INR1,890 crores in Q2, bringing the cumulative FY27 inflow to INR4,801 crores. The consolidated order backlog, including mining, stood at INR56,729 crores. Management highlighted strong growth in infrastructure construction and mining operations, driven by private sector investments in power capacity expansion.

attchmntText: Power Mech Projects Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Power Mech Projects Limited filed an updated investor presentation regarding un-audited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of INR 1,609 crore, a 30% year-on-year increase. EBITDA stood at INR 187 crore with an 11.55% margin. Profit after tax was INR 88 crore, up 12.5% year-on-year. The order book backlog is INR 56,729 crore. Year-to-date order inflows for FY 27 total INR 4,801 crore. The presentation is available on the company website.
